transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Wednesday, September 23. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. UP man accused of killing wife, 2 priests shot dead after 7-hour standoff. A police encounter resulted in the death of Arvind Singh after he refused to surrender during a standoff. During the incident, he was holding his three children hostage, leading to a police operation. Arvind had killed his wife and two priests following a dispute concerning a religious ritual at home. His eight-year-old son was also critically injured and later died from his injuries. No rule stops airport companies from having airlines: Government. Weighing pros and cons, no decision is taken yet: Civil aviation minister Ram Mohan Naidu 'I can start my senior career confidently': Anahat Singh on what comes next. Anahat Singh has finished with the juniors, winning the World Junior Championship in her final year. Now comes the Asian Games, where she is the third seed in the women's singles draw and the gold carries a quota place for LA 2028. After a senior breakthrough in Hong Kong, she is working on her physicality, learning from Gregory Gaultier and Saurav Ghosal, and taking it one event at a time. MediaTek targets Qualcomm's fortress with an unmatched new weapon. MediaTek has taken the lead over Qualcomm by launching the Dimensity 9600 Pro, the world's first flagship smartphone chip built on TSMC's 2nm process. The move signals MediaTek's aggressive push into the premium Android market, offering top-tier performance, efficiency, camera power, and on-device AI at a competitive price. In a first, US F-35 fighters to take part in IAF exercise. Tejas Mk1A induction likely in a month or two: IAF vice-chief Heavy LHB bogie corrosion worries Railways; toilet leaks, saline air blamed. Recently senior railway engineers have raised concerns over heavy corrosion in the bogies of LHB passenger coaches, despite the use of materials that are designed to resist corrosion and efforts to strengthen cleaning and maintenance practices. 'Vande Mataram' row: Courts can't dictate what nat'l song should be, says SC. Supreme Court on Tuesday agreed to examine the legality of penal consequences if a person does not sing the national song due to religious beliefs or conscientious objection, but declined to adjudicate whether 'Vande Mataram' should comprise two or six stanzas, saying it was best left to Parliament's wisdom. Trump officials hold 3-hour meeting with Iran mediators: All you need to know. US President Donald Trump said US special envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner were part of the American team that met with Iranian officials and mediators in New York, with the talks lasting around three hours as Washington and Tehran face renewed pressure to reach an agreement. Why children hide school marks from parents, according to psychology. Many children conceal their underwhelming academic performance due to the weight of parental expectations. Disheartening interactions with parents can push students towards disengagement strategies in coping with stress. Conversely, when parents offer support, it nurtures a willingness to tackle academic difficulties. If children believe their achievements determine parental approval, they may also experience heightened anxiety during tests. US approves $425 million sale of MH-60R Seahawk helicopters and equipments to Denmark. International News: The United States has approved the potential sale of MH-60R Seahawk helicopters and related equipment to Denmark in a deal estimated at $425 million, . Exorbitant pricing of drugs is 'extortion': Supreme Court. Expressing shock over patients and their families being fleeced by pharma companies and retail medicine sellers, Supreme Court on Tuesday said the exorbitant prices charged was nothing but "dacoity" in broad daylight and questioned the govt's silence on the pressing issue faced by citizens. Terry Bradshaw's $22.5M ranch: How did his 744-acre estate grow?. Terry Bradshaw's vast Oklahoma ranch, spanning 744 acres and once a thriving quarter horse breeding and cattle operation, has officially sold for $22.5 million. This property also served as the backdrop for the show 'The Bradshaw Bunch.' After a lengthy five-year period and an earlier failed sale, the transaction has finally been completed. Bradshaw and his wife will now focus their equestrian business on a smaller ranch in Texas.

transcript.title: Money, tax and personal finance
transcript.text: Now to your money — taxes, savings and personal finance. EPFO fund withdrawal rules for illness: How much EPF can you withdraw for medical treatment?. Eligible Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) members can withdraw up to 75 percent of their EPF balance for illness-related expenses after completing 12 months of EPF membership. Thinking about your next money move? Here's how crypto is gaining traction among Gen Z investors. Gen Z is emerging as a major crypto investor group in India, accounting for around half of new registrations in H1 2026. A new report shows that Indian investors bought around 7 percent more crypto than they sold. UPI versus debit versus credit cards: Will UPI payments with MDR charges still be cheapest? NPCI explains. After the MDR charge announcement on certain merchant UPI transactions, many UPI users are thinking whether they should shift from the UPI to a debit card or a credit card for daily transactions. 5 investment lessons from Kauṭilya's Arthashastra: Handling money in 2026 the Chanakya way. Chanakya's Arthashastra offers timeless insights into wealth and budgeting. Here are 5 investment lessons that are still relevant in 2026. 8th Pay Commission: Pensioners seek 11-year restoration period of commuted pension, cite HC judgment. 8th Pay Commission news: Bharat Pensioners' Samaj has urged the Centre and 8th Pay Commission to reduce the restoration period for commuted pension from 15 to 11 years. The demand follows the Himachal Pradesh High Court's September 16 judgment, which called for examination under changed actuarial conditions. BPS seeks a fresh actuarial review and reforms. Form 141 for TDS: What taxpayers need to know about the new challan-cum-statement under the Income Tax Act 2025. Form 141 is the new unified challan-cum-statement for specified TDS transactions under the Income Tax Act 2025. Know who needs to file it, which transactions it covers, the applicable deadlines, and how to submit the form. Your house is worth rupees 2 crore, but are you really retirement ready?. While an expensive home is nothing less than an achievement, you must remember that the house in which you live produces no rent at all. Appreciation may increase your estate, but it does not pay this month's grocery bill and the cost of that Sony PlayStation you wanted to gift to your grandchild. So, there are some questions that you need to ask for a well-planned retirement. Indian households' savings mix shifts: Mutual funds and equity gain, insurance flows weaken , what it means. Indian households' financial savings mix is changing, with mutual funds seeing the sharpest rise in inflows over three years. Equity has also grown from a small base, while deposits remain the largest avenue. Life insurance and small savings have seen weaker or uneven flows. NPS Vatsalya: Want to register a complaint? Here's how to access grievance redressal online , Stepwise guide. NPS Vatsalya, allows parents or guardians to open and operate a pension account for minor(s) till they become an adult. Today we take a look at how the subscribers can access grievance redressal online. EPF wage ceiling at rupees 25,000: What it means for employees, employers and take-home pay. The Union Cabinet approved raising the EPF wage ceiling to rupees 25,000. This change impacts mandatory PF contributions for employers and employees. Actual PF contributions depend on an employee's defined wage structure. Employers must bear their increased PF share as a statutory cost. Gifted assets to your spouse? Know when clubbing of income rules apply, who pays tax and how to report it in ITR. Gifted money or assets between spouses do not always shift the tax liability to the recipient. Under clubbing rules, income from assets transferred without adequate consideration can be taxed in the transferor's hands. Here's when the rules apply and what taxpayers should report. 100 percent family pension and NPS-related benefits: Know who is eligible to get extraordinary pension benefits in Railways. The railway employees' new pension guidelines have been announced, slated for implementation in 2026. These provisions classify both death and disability incidents into four specific categories. Notably, Categories B and D are set to receive enhanced pension benefits under this framework. Additionally, the family pension rates differ considerably according to the deceased employee's category, with added protections against any delays in payments and supplementary allowances for caregivers. From traditional saving to advanced leveraging and collaboration, this shows that a financial mindset and creative use of resources drive wealth. 8th pay commission panel to visit Mumbai next month , Here's how to apply, deadline, dates of meetings. The 8th CPC is scheduled to be in Mumbai next month to host discussions and meetings with employee unions, representative groups, pensioner associations, federations, and other stakeholders. rupees 14.42 lakh Belgium salary of IT pro triggered tax demand in India after Form 67 was missed; ITAT Bangalore gives relief. Employee with rupees 14.42 lakh salary pays rupees 4.53 lakh income tax in Belgium and asks for credit under the India-Belgium DTAA; Income Tax Department denied it as no Form 67 was filed; ITAT Bangalore orders relief for him. Will she have to pay capital gains tax on the gift to me? DA news: Delhi govt to consult labour dept amid DTC drivers' strike , Here's a look at the top demands, latest updates. The Delhi government plans to consult the labour department regarding the striking DTC drivers' salaries. They have threatened 'kaam bandh' on September 28 if demands such as DA and contract workers' regularisation are not met. Want cheaper flights or easy lounge access? How Air India's Maharaja Club points can help you. Maharaja Club, Air India's travel and lifestyle programme, allows members to earn Maharaja Points across Air India, Air India Express, Star Alliance partner airlines and 100+ travel, hospitality, retail, lifestyle and financial services partners.
